bounded_objective: Replace the prior single parity-hyperplane calculation by a coherent union of two affine plateaued cosets and determine whether the 3I GU payment survives without double charging upper cones.
method: Classify the two physical restrictions of a quadratic phase as character translates; prove an affine equal-fiber coset-merge lemma; split coincident and disjoint support cases; exact exhaustive convention check through n=5.
prior_status: GU'(3,0) was proved only for the restriction-closed clique-quadratic tensor class; arbitrary changing plateaued supports were unpaid.
mathematical_delta: Every quadratic phase of arbitrary rank and affine shift obeys the coordinatewise Delta_i U<=3 Inf_i bound, hence G<=3I. The proof replaces a coherent union of two translated plateaued cosets by one equal-fiber merge bit. The constant 3 is the sharp supremum. Also U<=I and H<=2I on the class.

case_extension.starting_class: Finite products of clique-quadratic blocks and, separately, individual bent quadratic phases.
case_extension.new_class: All quadratic Boolean phases, equivalently arbitrary alternating polar matrices of every rank with arbitrary affine terms; closed under every physical restriction and disjoint product.
case_extension.quantifiers: Every dimension, rank, affine shift, quadratic graph/overlap pattern and physical coordinate.
case_extension.previous_bound: GU'(3,0) only on the clique subclass; G/I<3 formula only for nonsingular polar matrices.
case_extension.new_bound: Coordinatewise Delta_i U<=3 Inf_i and globally GU'(3,0) on the whole quadratic class; U<=I and H<=2I.
case_extension.parameter_dependence: None in dimension, rank, active-row count, overlap, support size or restriction depth.
case_extension.universal_gap: Degree>=3 restrictions need not be flat translated cosets, so cross/within upper-fiber ratios are not empty-or-equal.
